title: A work order open on release day keeps Default for new parts
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Use the staging site, where the Tiered Pricing release is deployed on top of data from before the release.
  • Before the release is deployed to staging, have a work order for this test, work order 1, for a customer made for this test, customer A, left open.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, made after the deploy, pricing a new category made for this test, category A, with Default Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier B, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 10, made after the deploy.
  • Make sure customer A is put on tier B for work orders after the deploy.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click Add Part under line 1.
  3. Type a description in Description (for example Test part).
  4. Type 1 in Qty.
  5. Pick category A in Category.
  6. Type 100.00 in Cost.
  7. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • A new part row opens under line 1 with Part number, Description, Qty, Category, Cost and Sell price boxes and Save and Cancel.

Step 3:

  • Description holds the typed text.

Step 4:

  • Qty holds 1.

Step 5:

  • Category shows category A.

Step 6:

  • Cost holds 100.00 as typed.

Step 7:

  • The part fills in at $135.00, Default's price ($100.00 × 1.35), not tier B's $121.50.

AUTOMATION: HOLD - needs data made on staging before the Tiered Pricing release is deployed there; run on staging after the deploy
